protocol.entryQualityStage: Exploratory extension after initial basket results were inspected. Later periods are reused research data, not new holdouts. No production filters added.
protocol.entryEvidence: Snapshot observed time must be no later than trade entry; missing feature values reject the gated entry. Relative ATR .75–1.75, aligned observed HTF, volume ratio >=1, observed spread <=0.10 stop distance; no label-derived inputs.
protocol.selection: Maximize worst training-half stressed return minus drawdown penalty plus 0.1 times full training return minus 0.02 per config; penalty 0.8 Funded, 0.4 others. Ties prefer fewer configs then lexical IDs.
protocol.risk: Unchanged live House-Money and exposure functions; unchanged Part 1 bookkeeping and phase progression.
protocol.coverage: Require contiguous full coverage for both train and validation; this uses dates, not validation outcomes.
protocol.validation: Later source periods previously examined in research; not untouched holdouts. No validation tuning or winner replacement.
limitations: Realized-close drawdown excludes intratrade/floating equity and can understate prop breaches.
Source ledgers contain account-admitted trades, not every eligible scanner opportunity. Replay cannot synthesize previously rejected replacement entries.
End-open and unpriced Friday exposure are reported, not marked using future exit prices.
Training interval returns are not monthly returns; cohort accounts and overlapping histories must not be summed.
No historical selection guarantees future returns; multiple-comparison trial counts are disclosed.
